description: Build and sign a four-axis AttributionPrimitive for an action. Axes: D (data sources), P (protocol modules), G (delegation chain), C (compute providers). Returns the complete signed object.

action.description: Action identity tuple; the action_ref is derived as sha256(canonical(this))

axes.description: Four-axis content. See spec §1.2 for entry shapes per axis.

issuer.description: Issuer DID (gateway or agent producing the receipt)

issuer_private_key.description: Ed25519 private key hex that signs the envelope

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC with ms precision + Z (§2.5). Defaults to now().

name: aps_construct_attribution_primitive
